content: The test image shows a soybean stem with a brown, shredded/fibrous necrotic lesion — the cortex has rotted away revealing fibrous inner tissue. This is a stem disease, not a leaf disease. Top candidates: Anthracnose (dark stem cankers), Phomopsis (tan-brown stem blight), Charcoal Rot, or Rhizoctonia.

The Anthracnose reference shows brown stems with dark lesions throughout. The test image has a localized, fibrous/shredded brown lesion at a node — more consistent with Anthracnose stem canker, which causes necrosis at nodes with a shredded cortex appearance as tissue dries out.
